name: Masters of Horror
source: Sylvania Supplement, Grade 2a warband, converted from mordheimer.net (/docs/warbands/grade-2a-warbands/masters-of-horror) on 2026-10-10.

heroSlots.notes: Weapons/Armour: A Mad Scientist may be equipped from the Horror Hero Equipment list.

specialRules.name: Leader
specialRules.description: Any models in the warband within 6" of the Mad Scientist may use his Leadership value.

specialRules.name: Immune to Psychology
specialRules.description: Mad Scientists are not affected by psychology (such as fear) due to the shattered state of their minds.

heroSlots.notes: Weapons/Armour: Thralls may be equipped from the Horror Hero Equipment List.

specialRules.name: Cause Fear
specialRules.description: Vampires are terrifying Undead creatures and therefore cause Fear.

specialRules.name: Immune to Psychology
specialRules.description: Vampires are not affected by psychology (such as fear) and never leave combat.

specialRules.name: Immune to Poison
specialRules.description: Vampires are not affected by any poison.

specialRules.name: No Pain
specialRules.description: Vampires treat a Stunned result on the Injury chart as Knocked Down.

heroSlots.notes: Weapons/Armour: A werewolf cannot bear equipment. They attack with tooth and claw,and suffer no penalties for doing so.
Weapons/Armour: Hunchbacks may be equipped from the Horror Hero Equipment List.

henchmenTypes.notes: Weapons/Armour: Zombies never carry any equipment, and do not suffer any penalties for this.

specialRules.name: Cause Fear
specialRules.description: Zombies are terrifying Undead creatures and therefore cause Fear.

specialRules.name: May not Run
specialRules.description: Zombies are slow Undead creatures and may not run (but may charge normally).

specialRules.name: Immune to Psychology
specialRules.description: Zombies are not affected by psychology.

specialRules.name: Immune to Poison
specialRules.description: Zombies are immune to poisons.

specialRules.name: No Pain
specialRules.description: Zombies treat Stunned results on the Injury table as Knocked Down.

specialRules.name: No Brain
specialRules.description: Zombies do not gain experience.

henchmenTypes.notes: Weapons/Armour: Flesh Constructs do not use weapons, and suffer no penalties.

specialRules.name: Cause Fear
specialRules.description: Flesh Constructs are terrifying Undead creatures and therefore cause Fear.

specialRules.name: Immune to Psychology
specialRules.description: Flesh Constructs are not affected by psychology.

specialRules.name: Immune to Poison
specialRules.description: Flesh Constructs are immune to poisons.

specialRules.name: No Pain
specialRules.description: Flesh Constructs treat Stunned results as Knocked Down.

specialRules.name: A Bit Unhinged
specialRules.description: Flesh Constructs do not gain experience normally. They must make a successful Leadership test in order to gain the experience for surviving the game; dead brains can only be expected to learn so much, after all.

specialRules.name: Its only a flesh wound
specialRules.description: When a Flesh Construct is taken OOA, roll on the Henchmen Injury table as normal. On a roll of 1-2, the player is able to repair the damage to the golem for D6x5gc (to represent the time and effort it takes to obtain new parts). If the warband is unable to pay for the extra part immediately, the Construct is not able to participate in the next battle. It will remain on the roster until abandoned or repaired.

specialRules.name: Cannot Run
specialRules.description: After being pieced together from various stiffs, ones legs are often, well, stiff. Constructs may still charge normally.

henchmenTypes.notes: Weapons/Armour: The Bitten may be armed from the Bitten Equipment List.

specialRules.name: Transform
specialRules.description: Roll a D6 each turn and consult the following. Once transformed, the Bitten cast off all equipment (save for a dagger) and suffer no penalties for fighting unarmed. 1: Madness: your Bitten suffers from Stupidity this turn. If Transformed, they revert to human form. 2 to 5: Act as normal 6: Transformed: your Bitten gains Frenzy and Sprint. This lasts until a 1 is rolled. Transformed do not roll when in combat.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Chainsaw Sword
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Strength As user. Fear: Incredibly loud and belching forth a sickly green smoke, this weapon causes even seasoned soldiers to quiver. A model bearing a Chainsaw Sword causes Fear. Shredder: The Chainsaw sword rips and chews through armour as if it were cloth. All blows from a Chainsaw Sword are at -2 Armour Save.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Electric Trident
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Strength As user. Zzap!: So stunning is the Electric Trident that a model wounded by it is considered Stunned on a roll of 2-4. Shocking: On a natural 6 To-Hit followed by a natural 6 To-Wound, the Electric Trident discharges a field 2" around the target. All models (save for the bearer of the weapon) are struck with a S3 hit. Nail in Boot: If a D6 roll of 1 occurs on the To-Hit roll with the Trident, the bearer is struck with a S3 hit.

exclusiveEquipment.name: Repeater Pistol
exclusiveEquipment.rulesText: Range 8". Strength 4. Save Modifier: Pistols are even better at penetrating armour than their Strength of 4 suggests. A model taking a wound from a Repeater Pistol must take its armour save at -2. Too Much Tinkering: The Repeater Pistol is a heavily modified weapon. To represent its unstable mechanics, each time the trigger is pulled, you must roll a D6. On a roll of 4+, the pistol works fine. On a roll of 2-3, the pistol does nothing. One a roll of 1, roll on the "Misfire" Chart. Repeater: The Repeater Pistol has the possibility of firing more than once during the Shooting phase. For each additional shot, you must roll a D6 at -1 on the above table. For example, for one shot, you must roll a 4+, with a roll of a 1 forcing a roll on the Misfire Table. For a second shot, you need a 5+, with a roll of 1-2 forcing a roll on the misfire table. Of course, it is impossible to attempt more than 3 shots per round.

specialRules: Hired Swords: Masters of Horror warbands may hire the same Hired Swords as an Undead warband. | No Promotion: Neither Zombies nor Flesh Constructs may become Heroes through Lads Got Talent. | Wolfman max stats: M 6 WS 4 BS 3 S 5 T 4 W 3 I 7 A 4 Ld 8
background: Lightning flashes across the dark sky as cackling arises from a ruined tower. "It's Alive!" echoes across the dead woods that surround the crumbling edifice before the thunder pounces and swallows it whole. The heavy door is drawn aside by a dwarf-like man, as he quickly makes way for his Master and his latest creation. Stumbling on ever-still legs, the monstrous being sets foot upon the soft mossy earth, leaving large impressions in its wake. | Insane giggling follows it, as the once-acclaimed Scientist follows his golem, armed with his deranged intellect and arsenal of mutated fiends. He seeks to bring pain and suffering to those who cast him out of Altdorf, but to do so he'll need wyrdstone to power his inventions. Off to Mordheim they move...
